description: This file defines a utility function 'shapeStackedSeries' that processes an array of cost records into a format suitable for rendering stacked series charts, particularly with the Recharts library. It involves data transformation, categorization, sorting, and zero-filling of stacks.

methods.name: shapeStackedSeries(records, stackBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw cost data into a structured dataset for visualization, organizing records by service and category, filling missing data with zeros, and sorting as specified.
